a.lede: A dedicated network for smart home devices may sound excessive, but there may be reasons to separate those gadgets from everything else on your network.
a.title: Should you keep your smart home gadgets on a separate home network?

b.lede: It may be more economical to hold onto gadgets for as long as possible, but you're putting your entire home network at risk with outdate hardware.
b.title: The oldest gadget in your house could be your home network's biggest security hole
